item.description:
Herbert Grönemeyer "Unplugged 2 • Von allem anders"
Dolby Atmos Music



1995. Babelsberg Studios in Potsdam. With the very first non-English-language MTV Unplugged, Herbert Grönemeyer made music history. And now, exactly thirty years later, the equipment is being unplugged again. Unplugged 2 • Completely different: the Unplugged album with everything that came after and everything yet to come. Recorded in the legendary Hansa Studios in Berlin, together with friends, companions, and guests such as Balbina, BRKN, Lea, Peter Fox, and Lucry & Suena, the captivating 64-member Berlin Radio Choir, an orchestra, and various string ensembles. All songs newly arranged and reinvented. Unwired, unamplified, and pure.
